description: Defines the TcpCubicSenderBytes class implementing TCP Cubic congestion control algorithm with bytes-based window management for QUIC protocol.

classes.name: TcpCubicSenderBytes
classes.description: Implements TCP Cubic congestion control for QUIC, managing congestion window in bytes, with support for slow start, loss recovery, and bandwidth estimation.

methods.name: TcpCubicSenderBytes
methods.description: Constructor initializing congestion control with parameters like clock, RTT stats, initial window, and max window.

methods.name: SetFromConfig
methods.description: Configures congestion control parameters from QUIC configuration.

methods.name: AdjustNetworkParameters
methods.description: Adjusts congestion control based on network parameters.

methods.name: SetNumEmulatedConnections
methods.description: Sets the number of emulated connections for congestion control.

methods.name: SetInitialCongestionWindowInPackets
methods.description: Sets initial congestion window in packets.

methods.name: OnConnectionMigration
methods.description: Handles connection migration events.

methods.name: OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Handles congestion events, updating congestion window based on ACKs and losses.

methods.name: OnPacketSent
methods.description: Handles packet sent events.

methods.name: OnPacketNeutered
methods.description: Handles packet neutering (no operation).

methods.name: OnRetransmissionTimeout
methods.description: Handles retransmission timeout events.

methods.name: CanSend
methods.description: Determines if data can be sent based on current congestion window.

methods.name: PacingRate
methods.description: Calculates pacing rate based on current congestion state.

methods.name: BandwidthEstimate
methods.description: Returns current bandwidth estimate.

methods.name: GetCongestionWindow
methods.description: Returns current congestion window in bytes.

methods.name: GetSlowStartThreshold
methods.description: Returns slow start threshold.

methods.name: GetCongestionControlType
methods.description: Returns congestion control type.

methods.name: InSlowStart
methods.description: Checks if in slow start phase.

methods.name: InRecovery
methods.description: Checks if in recovery phase.

methods.name: GetDebugState
methods.description: Returns debug string representing internal state.

methods.name: OnApplicationLimited
methods.description: Handles application-limited events.

methods.name: min_congestion_window
methods.description: Returns minimum congestion window.

methods.name: RenoBeta
methods.description: Computes Reno beta based on number of connections.

methods.name: IsCwndLimited
methods.description: Checks if congestion window limits sending.

methods.name: OnPacketAcked
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of packets.

methods.name: SetCongestionWindowFromBandwidthAndRtt
methods.description: Sets congestion window based on bandwidth and RTT.

methods.name: SetMinCongestionWindowInPackets
methods.description: Sets minimum congestion window in packets.

methods.name: ExitSlowstart
methods.description: Exits slow start phase.

methods.name: OnPacketLost
methods.description: Handles packet loss events.

methods.name: MaybeIncreaseCwnd
methods.description: Potentially increases congestion window.

methods.name: HandleRetransmissionTimeout
methods.description: Handles retransmission timeout logic.
